description: Establish and confirm a green baseline on the host: install pnpm deps, approve the ignored native build scripts (onnxruntime-node, esbuild), install Playwright browsers, and run the existing typecheck + build + full test suite + offline benchmark so later changes have a trustworthy reference. The orchestrator already verified this passes; this feature makes the setup reproducible and confirms the coder's environment matches (all dependencies present, 263 tests green, WebKit self-skipping is expected).
steps: Run `pnpm install` at the repo root (/projects/sandbox/laya-browser-mcp).
Run `pnpm rebuild onnxruntime-node esbuild` to build the native binaries whose build scripts pnpm ignores by default (required later so the real ONNX engine can load).

Run `pnpm exec playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell firefox` to install the browser binaries the tests launch. WebKit is not launchable in this sandbox (missing system shared libs) and its smoke test self-skips, which is expected.
Run `pnpm run typecheck` and confirm it exits 0 with no errors.
Run `pnpm run build` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `pnpm test` and confirm the suite is green (expected: ~263 passed, ~2 skipped; the only acceptable skips are the WebKit cross-browser block and the LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated real-weights tests).
Run `pnpm run bench` and confirm the offline stub benchmark prints its coverage table without error.
Record the exact command outputs (counts of passed/skipped tests, bench table) in the feature findings for later comparison.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm test` reports all tests passing except the expected WebKit self-skip and any LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated skips (no failures).
`pnpm run bench` completes and prints the coverage table.
node_modules, onnxruntime-node native binaries, and Playwright Chromium + Firefox are all present.
findings:
Green baseline confirmed on host (pnpm v10.28.1, network OPEN_INTERNET). No source code changed; verification/setup only.

SETUP:
- `pnpm install`: exit 0, 'Lockfile is up to date ... Already up to date'. Warned that build scripts for esbuild@0.28.2 and onnxruntime-node@1.30.0 are ignored by default.
- `pnpm rebuild onnxruntime-node esbuild`: exit 0. Native binaries built: node_modules/.pnpm/onnxruntime-node@1.30.0/.../bin/napi-v*/linux/x64/ contains libonnxruntime.so.1 and onnxruntime_binding.node; esbuild native bin reports 0.28.2 (@esbuild/linux-x64 present). NOTE: esbuild is a transitive dep and is NOT symlinked into node_modules/.bin, so `pnpm exec esbuild` fails with ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL; this is expected and not a problem (the native binary at node_modules/.pnpm/esbuild@0.28.2/node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild runs and prints 0.28.2).
- `pnpm exec playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell firefox`: exit 0 (printed 'BEWARE: your OS is not officially supported by Playwright; downloading fallback build for ubuntu24.04-x64.'). Installed under /opt/playwright: chromium-1243, chromium_headless_shell-1243, firefox-1543 (plus ffmpeg-1011 and older -1232 builds). WebKit intentionally NOT installed / not launchable in sandbox.

VERIFICATION:
- `pnpm run typecheck` (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit): exit 0, no errors.
- `pnpm run build` (tsc -p tsconfig.json): exit 0.
- `pnpm test` (vitest run): exit 0. Test Files 39 passed (39). Tests 263 passed | 3 skipped (266). Duration ~13.9s. The 3 skips are all EXPECTED, none are failures: test/cross-browser.test.ts (1 skipped = WebKit self-skip, binary cannot launch in sandbox), test/autopilot.test.ts (1 skipped = LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated real-weights block, line ~338), test/benchmark/report.test.ts (1 skipped = LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated real-model benchmark). Firefox and Chromium really launch (real-headless-chromium tests pass). NOTE: briefing estimated ~2 skips; the actual count is 3 because there are two LAYA_MODEL_DIR gates (autopilot + benchmark) plus the WebKit skip. All accounted for and expected.
- `pnpm run bench` (vitest run test/benchmark/report.test.ts): exit 0. Test Files 1 passed (1). Tests 2 passed | 1 skipped (3, the LAYA_MODEL_DIR gate). Offline StubEngine coverage table printed:
